text:
asha: Heads-up: Coriant Health renewal next Wed. During the pre-call probe they reported embedding delays (up to ~8s) on a few requests. I'm scheduling a tryback call but need eng triage before the renewal demo. What I did: reproduced with their sample traffic, grabbed request IDs, escalated to eng. Blockers: can't finalise the renewal deck until we confirm root cause. Today: asking eng for quick triage & possible rollback. @dan @jared

dan: Thanks @asha — pinged eng-runtime channel. Can you drop the request IDs and the model/route details?

asha: ReqIDs: r-8e7fd1, r-8e7fd2, r-8e7fd9 (full list in thread). Model: open-llama-7b-q4, route: coriant-prod-embed. Observed CPU fallback spikes around 15:03 UTC and a small burst of 5xx retries.

priya: Adding this to my queue. If it's KV-cache cold starts that could explain tail latency. @jared can you check cache hit rates and worker metrics for that customer?

jared: On it. Quick read: emb-worker-metrics show ~78% cache hit, but 99th percentile latency is 6.2s for those periods. Reproducing locally with their sample.

deploybot: deploybot: Canary rollback initiated for coriant-prod-embed: v1.3.4 -> v1.3.3 (canary 10% started at 22:10 UTC).

asha: Nice — once canary finishes can we run the pre-call flow? Also need confirmation this rollback won't touch other renewals live this week.

dan: I'll run a short smoke after canary finishes. @asha can you schedule two tryback slots (Thu 9am & Fri 3pm PST) so CS has flexibility?

asha: Scheduled Thu 09:00 PST and Fri 15:00 PST, invites sent to Coriant. Also drafting a short exec blurb in case rollback doesn't resolve things.

jared: Found a suspected regression in batching fast-path: for single-item requests + quantized kernel we hit a slower non-batched kernel in rare cases. Opening PR with test coverage. CR: #4021.

dan: CR received — I can review in about an hour.

asha: If the CR lands and tests pass, can we aim for a hotfix release tonight? Customer wants assurance before renewal call.

jared: If CI green, ETA ~4h for release and canary.

asha: :thumbsup: I'll update renewal notes and set expectations with Coriant. TL;DR: triage ongoing, canary rollback in flight, CR #4021 targets batching regression, renewal tryback scheduled Thu 09:00 PST. cc: @product for SLA note.
